reviewed_waivers: cpu_req_addr[1:0] unused because interface accepts aligned words only; importer/scoreboards assert alignment
limits: Simulator-dependent driver scheduling means correctness checks, not cycle equivalence between tools
Reset is shared with memory and cancels its outstanding epoch
Generic mapped cells are tool-dependent, not FPGA LUTs or process area
Functional wrappers disconnect debug counters; instrumented view retains all counters
No target timing, placement, power or bitstream result

audit.independence: Recomputed without importing benchmark metrics/runner modules
limits: This validates finite-suite arithmetic and integrity, not real application representativeness
Selection timestamp ordering follows retained runner command provenance; a matching seal alone is not an externally notarized experiment
